info.title: DevResponse API
info.description: Machine-facing REST surface (`/api/v1`). Authenticate with an API key (`drk_…`) or a JWT access token as `Authorization: Bearer …`. Scopes are the application permission keys; a credential can never exceed its owner's authority. Errors use RFC 7807 `application/problem+json`. Every response carries an `x-request-id` correlation header.
